# [SureGifts - Company Profile](https://www.suregifts.com.ng/)
## SureGifts - About the company
SureGifts is a seed company based in Lagos (Nigeria), founded in 2014 by [Adeoye Ojo](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/suregifts/__2-CVn-zfbTxIxovv5Uw_wmG9KuLLRAv66tfn0DL3Q6U#), [Olaoluwa Samuel-Biyi](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/suregifts/__2-CVn-zfbTxIxovv5Uw_wmG9KuLLRAv66tfn0DL3Q6U#) and [Babafemi Lawal](https://tracxn.com/d/companies/suregifts/__2-CVn-zfbTxIxovv5Uw_wmG9KuLLRAv66tfn0DL3Q6U#). SureGifts has raised an undisclosed amount in funding.
